That credential is the thing that changes my resume from 'former branch manager looking for work' to 'commercial lending credentialed finance professional with SBA product knowledge.' That is a different candidate. My action this tick is threefold: (1) Complete the remaining SBA 7(a) coursework modules and earn the certificate. The pitch: I am a credentialed commercial lending professional (SBA 7(a) certificate pending) with a decade of risk assessment and portfolio management experience, now exploring fit at mission-driven lending institutions. I am not mass-applying. I am targeting one high-fit institution at a time. The credit union is the right first call because they serve the small business community Kevin is also trying to reach — and because the disruption hitting auto lending is actually pushing demand toward local credit products.
